mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies at Harriet Park and a temperature of 67 degrees, with an air quality index of 51, which is considered moderate.

The city has two important updates. First, the Department of Public Works is recruiting an Engineering Technician to manage construction projects, with applications due September 20th. Also, the city has implemented a rain barrel rebate program offering 30 dollars for qualifying 35-gallon barrels to help manage stormwater.

There is plenty to do, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol and more live music at Paddy Mac's.
In a noteworthy call from August 15th, Verona police arrested a 44-year-old woman for her first O W I after she was observed swerving and eventually became unresponsive behind the wheel.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM, so stop by later today for a treat.
